standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma establishing the properties of the comparison of the fppf and etale topologies, in particular the exactness and full faithfulness of the pullback and the exactness of the pushforward on short exact sequences of sheaves in its image
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the weak Serre verification of the class of pulled back sheaves.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, the lemma listing the four conditions characterizing a weak Serre subcategory
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the four conditions checked for the subcategory of sheaves pulled back from the etale site.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change and restriction for finite morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the lemma that the base change of a finite morphism is finite, and Topologies, the lemma giving the commutative diagram of the morphism between the big and small etale sites

standard_prerequisites.name: The sheaf property and compatibility of the class with proper maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma describing the pullback along the projection for the fppf site, and part (4) of the lemma comparing the higher direct image for proper morphisms

standard_prerequisites.name: Domination of an fppf covering by a finite morphism etale locally
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms, the lemma that an fppf covering can be dominated, etale locally on the base, by a finite morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies property (item-refine-tau-by-P), that is, the refinement of an fppf covering by a finite morphism.

core_obligations: Show that the class A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 21684-21696): check conditions (1)-(4) of the cited homology criterion, where (1)-(3) are immediate from exactness and full faithfulness of pi_X^{-1}, and for (4) a short exact sequence 0 -> pi_X^{-1}F -> G -> pi_X^{-1}F' -> 0 pushes forward to an exact sequence 0 -> F -> pi_{X,*}G -> F' -> 0, so G = pi_X^{-1}pi_{X,*}G lies in A'_X.
Property (item-base-change-P) (proof lines 21698-21702): it holds because fibre products of schemes exist and the base change of a finite morphism is finite.
Property (item-restriction-A) (proof lines 21704-21707): it follows from the commutative diagram relating the big and small etale sites.

Properties (item-A-sheaf) and (item-A-and-P) (proof lines 21709-21715): the first is the lemma describing the pullback along the projection for the fppf site, the second is part (4) of the comparison lemma for proper morphisms.
Property (item-refine-tau-by-P) (proof lines 21717-21721): it is implied by the lemma that an fppf covering can be dominated by a finite morphism after an etale base change.
proof_roadmap: Verify the weak Serre conditions for the subcategory of sheaves pulled back along the projection from the etale site.
Check the four remaining properties one by one through the corresponding basic lemmas.
Refine an fppf covering by a finite morphism using the domination lemma.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies, for the comparison morphism from the fppf topology to the etale topology and with P the class of finite morphisms, the five standing properties (item-base-change-P), (item-restriction-A), (item-A-sheaf), (item-A-and-P) and (item-refine-tau-by-P) (statement lines 21665-21682). The proof (proof lines 21684-21722) shows first that the class A'_X of pulled back sheaves is a weak Serre subcategory via the four-part criterion and then checks each property through the corresponding basic lemma. H2: several independent verifications, each of them written out.
